bio.text: Cynthia Lummis was sworn into the U.S. Senate on January 3, 2021, becoming the first woman to serve as U.S. Senator from Wyoming.
She was first elected to the U.S. House in 2008 and left it in 2016, and earlier served as Wyoming State Treasurer for eight years and in the Wyoming State House and Senate for 14 years.
She was born on a cattle ranch in Laramie County and holds three degrees from the University of Wyoming, in animal science, biology and law.
